integrity_notes: Full theorem and proof are self-contained; finite exact-arithmetic diagnostics are supplemental, not substitutes for analytic steps. External independent scientific review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Inference presumes known positive Ornstein–Uhlenbeck drift and diffusion, exact zero resets, renewal independence, finite positive mean reset intervals, and equilibrium-time sampling. The inverse is discontinuous in total variation at smooth positive fixed-mean laws and cannot be determined from any fixed finite block of moments. The result does not establish finite-sample estimators or independent publication priority.
title: Stationary-marginal inversion for renewal-reset Ornstein–Uhlenbeck motion: exact identifiability and smooth instability
